authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data states that the Local plan boundary dataset contains the area each local plan covers and currently reports 364 local-plan boundaries; its specification requires a permanent boundary reference and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, with organisation linkage. A bounded window of at most 50 records was considered for the unresolved criterion. This source is capable of supplying an exact coverage polygon once an authoritative slot selector exists. However the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference, development-plan/local-plan reference, LPA/LAD identifier or name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Choosing any one of the 364 boundaries would therefore be an unsupported guess. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
